headline: As of 2026-10-29: 44,308,793 early/mail ballots cast nationally across 48 of 50 states, D+9.8 cast-ballot lean.
bullets: 44,308,793 early/mail ballots cast so far across 48 states reporting.
Across party-registration states, ballots cast lean D+9.8 by registration.
Most ballots cast: Texas (6,325,543), California (4,643,370), Florida (4,176,557).
